answer: The middle and third sections here were both under 1400 high, so 'a third section during a fade' stayed in the second section: read again in CAP-U9FADE4B.json. Back to the first during a fade: the first pair runs back from 0.768 to 1 in about 50 ms, 0.2 s times the way it had come. A wheel turn of 60 or a script scroll during a fade: the fade runs on with the same series and both pairs' tops move 60 with the page at once. A wheel turn of 600 with the pointer still: about 33 ms after the page moves, the section now under the pointer takes Add Section, on the same 0.2 s cross, with no pointer move. A move after that changes nothing. A press on a Button with nothing selected: nothing fades, nor at 2 px; the move to 14 px fades the pair out over 0.2 s. Let go at home: it stays out.
ours: Before this change: a copy left behind didn't move with a scroll, a section under a still pointer didn't take the chrome until the pointer moved, back on a falling section rose from 0 under the falling copy, and a press alone faded Add Section, because ours selects on the press. After it: the same as the oracle in each (npm run marks-check, U9 cases).
differs: Fixed here. Ours still selects a block on the press, the oracle on letting go (CAP-U9FADE4D.json): only Add Section's fade waits now.
notRead: A wheel turn over the section's own buttons. A press with another block already selected. Selecting and Escape within the same 0.2 s.
